This suggests the visual features (circular dial, needle) are ambiguous and lack the specific distinguishing markers of a barometer (like pressure units 'mb' or 'inHg'), reinforcing the 'text gibberish' artifact. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted slight noise/grain, which aligns with the low-resolution/vintage aesthetic but doesn't rule out AI generation artifacts.
